description: Search the Gearlist catalog of source-checked AI agent tools, MCP servers and skills. Matches words in the name, category, description, audience and access notes, best match first. Each result includes its access notes, which you should show the human. Entries are documentation-checked only, not installed or audited.

category.description: Optional. Limit results to one category. list_categories gives the names and counts.

limit.description: How many entries to return, from 1 to 50. Default 10.

query.description: Words to look for, for example 'browser automation' or 'send email'. Entries that match every word come first, then entries that match some of them. Common words such as 'the' or 'tool' are ignored. Use an empty string with a category to list that category.

name: search_gear

match.description: all: every result matches every word. partial: some results match only some words, listed after the full matches. none: nothing matched.

access_notes.description: The accounts, data, devices or payments it needs. Show this to the human.

added.description: Date the entry was added to Gearlist, YYYY-MM-DD. 2026-10-30 is the earliest date Gearlist records, and means on or before that date.

id.description: Stable Gearlist id. Pass it to get_gear.

licence.description: The licence, when the entry records one.

source_checked.description: Date the source was read, YYYY-MM-DD.

source_url.description: The public source that was read.

thl_project.description: True when Tech Horizon Labs makes the project.

total_matches.description: Entries that match at least one word.

title: Search Gearlist
